image_description: An open vintage comic book or graphic novel spread, displaying two pages with sequential panel layouts. The artwork features hand-drawn illustrations in a classic mid-20th-century style with muted colors (yellows, reds, greens). Panels contain characters in suits and period clothing, speech bubbles with legible text, and caption boxes. The paper appears aged/yellowed with visible binding curvature at the spine.

This is a common AI artifact where text structure is mimicked but semantic coherence fails at the character level.

The texture of the paper is overly uniform and smooth, lacking the microscopic fiber detail of real aged paper. Ink lines show slight bleeding inconsistencies that don't perfectly match the paper absorption, suggesting digital generation rather than physical printing.
The individual pages on the left edge blend together slightly without distinct separation lines, appearing as a fused block rather than stacked sheets. This is a subtle geometric inconsistency.
